param: Α Recruitment rate of human. From Table 1: 1000 / (65*12) per month.
β Probability of successful infection rate. From Table 1, Range: [0.01, 5].
σ Correction parameter for reinfection term. From Table 1, Range: [0, 1].
v Rate of vaccination. From Table 1, Range: [0,1].
ε Vaccine wane rate. From Table 1, Range: [0.067, 0.1].
γ Recovery rate. From Table 1, Range: [0.5, 2].
δ Drop out rate due to waning immunity from recovered. From Table 1, Range: [0.003, 0.02].
μ Natural death rate. From Table 1: 1 / (65*12) per month.
β_reinfection Effective reinfection rate, which is the product of the infection rate and the reinfection correction factor.
